title: implement-ticket's Test phase is bounded on a capped host and reports an environment death as its own verdict
summary: capped_pytest helper chunks the Test phase under the host cap from registries/session_test_caps.yaml, the test-scope gate requires it on a capped host, and TESTS_ENVIRONMENT_FAILED is a distinct verdict recorded before any Test:passed row

title: On host ubuntu, ENOMEM appeared in the Test phase while MemAvailable was several GB; commit pressure rejected, cause open
summary: read-only committed-memory breakdown by process kind, kernel mode-0 mechanism checked in the v6.17 source, fork probe at 0.5/1/2 GB and a capped 4,300-test single process found no ENOMEM; the hypothesis is rejected and the 2026-11-15 cause is unresolved, with an options list for the owner
